description: Trafiköar is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Eskilstuna kommun. Street department's inventoried traffic islands (road sign embedded in a signpost arch attached to a fixed or movable concrete structure in the street environment). The information is used to manage the operation and maintenance of traffic islands in the city by showing, for example, which road signs have damage. Coverage: Eskilstuna kommun. The portal shows the English title as "Category: Traffic islands" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Eskilstuna kommun. Its keywords include trafik, trafiköar, drift. The listing shows 1 download or service links in JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
